name: @postbote/gnome
description: GNOME Online Accounts (GOA) + Evolution Data Server binding: accounts, contacts, calendar, and the IMAP credentials the mail layer connects with. One implementation for every runtime (GJS native gi://, Node/Bun via @gjsify/node-gi); the GOA/EDS typelibs load on first use, and a host without them answers with GnomeUnavailableError. Needs a GNOME session with GOA/EDS running — nothing is bundled or published.
